description: Stakeholder map — Stakeholder map for a project or change (required) with optional stakeholders (name: role, separated by |) and context. Rates each stakeholder 1-5 on power and interest with stance (champion..resistant), concerns, needs, engagement action, channel and frequency; places them offline on the Mendelow grid (MANAGE CLOSELY / KEEP SATISFIED / KEEP INFORMED / MONITOR), lists high-power blockers and champions, computes a power-weighted support score and readiness FAVORABLE/NEEDS WORK/AT RISK, plus key messages, risks and a markdown table. Without a list it infers typical stakeholders and marks them inferred. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

project.description: e.g. Migrate billing from Stripe to an in-house system
